request.spec:
While an as-of date is set, the roles shown on the screen are those in force at the end of that
day.

agent.result_text:
I made no changes: the app already does what this request asks, and `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests in the spec (the main "as of roles" test plus scenarios 1–3).

Here is how the existing code covers it:

- **Server:** When an as-of date is set, `SettingController.get` passes it to `SettingService.asOf(sheet, day)` (`src/main/java/net/officefloor/hq/app/setting/SettingService.java:105`). Every time a role is set, `setRole` also saves it to the setting history under the key `role:<user>`, dated with the sheet's today. `asOf` rebuilds each user's role from the history saved on or before the as-of day, so it shows the roles in force at the end of that day. A user whose role was only set after that day isn't listed.
- **Front end:** The roles table in `src/main/frontend/src/app/features/settings/settings.ts:781` (`role-row-<user>` / `role-value`) shows the settings the server returns, so it changes with the as-of date and goes back to current roles when the date is cleared.
- **Audit:** The `ROLE_SET` and other records match what the test expects.

One edge case: a role set before the history was kept has no dated record, so it shows as it stands now whatever the as-of date. The other settings in that view work the same way.
